title: Weights
edition_version: Version of record unless otherwise noted
relevance: Weights extends shape computation beyond bare geometry. Labels classify elements; weights let properties such as line thickness or tone participate in matching and combination.
prerequisites: Undergraduate algebra and linear algebra; additional prerequisites in topic notes

license_redistribution.conditions: No public redistribution permission verified; citation and lawful reading link only.

verification.scope: Primary scan: shape and label foundations, numerical-weight operations, weighted part relations, and the final coordinated-description example. Selected definitions and examples were reviewed with OCR and visual checking of p. 416. Other property algebras are not assumed to behave identically to the numerical example.
